title: Annotatio IV §.II: Dispute on John 6 — is it about the Lord’s Supper? Both sides true
pass_a_gloss: Indeed concerning John 6, it has long enough and sharply been disputed, even among theologians of the same Christian sect: Whether in it there is discourse of the Lord’s Supper, of the sacramental presence and eating of flesh and drinking of Christ’s blood? Some holding the affirmative, others the negative, and defending with great effort. But that lawsuit is easily so composed that each side is understood to have spoken truth.
pass_b_english: Long sharp fight even within the same Christian camp: does John 6 treat the Lord’s Supper and sacramental eating/drinking of Christ’s flesh and blood?
Some yes, some no — both sides can be true once the dispute is composed.
source_text: Equidem de Joh. 6., id diu satis & acriter disceptatum est, etiam inter ejusdem Sectæ Christianæ Theologos: Num in eo, de Cœna Domini, de præsentia & manducatione carnis & bibitione sanguinis Christi Sacramentalibus agatur? Aliis affirmativam, negativam aliis, tenentibus magnoque tuentibus conatu. At litigium istud facilè ita componitur, ut utraque pars verum dixisse intelligatur.
